descriptions.dean: Authorized to review, approve, or reject departmental expense claims, grant allocations, and academic research requests.
descriptions.student: Submits educational expense reimbursement requests and tracks individual research laboratory budget allocations.
descriptions.sysadmin: Granted full global access to monitor system audit logs, manage configuration parameters, and orchestrate workspace security rules.
descriptions.teacher: Submits educational expense reimbursement requests and tracks individual research laboratory budget allocations. Authorizes initial student reimbursement claims within their specific faculty perimeter.
descriptions.finance: Authorized to conduct university-wide financial audits, monitor institutional budget caps, and grant final budget approvals for projects and events.

showcase.title: Academic Budget & Reimbursement Governance
showcase.subtitle: An independent full-stack financial workflow engine enforcing ex-ante budget authorization, role isolation, and real-time auditability.

approval.heading: Ex-Ante Approval & Reimbursement Pipeline
approval.l3Desc: Submit a pre-purchase expense proposal with estimated budget allocation before spending.
approval.l2Desc: Verify academic legitimacy and approve the request, atomically reserving departmental funds.
approval.executionGate: Approved → Execute purchase & upload actual receipts for settlement
approval.l1Desc: Reconcile post-purchase receipts against the approved cap and disburse reimbursement.

jit.heading: Google SSO & JIT Account Provisioning
jit.subtitle: No manual password signup is required. First-time institutional Google logins follow an automated 4-step activation flow:
jit.step1Desc: Sign in with your university Google account (@ntust.edu.tw) to verify domain identity.
jit.step2Desc: First-time users are routed to /onboarding to bind Student/Lecturer ID and department.
jit.step3Desc: Profile enters Pending review (/waiting-approval) until SysAdmin validates credentials.
jit.step4Desc: Once Active, subsequent Google logins enter /dashboard directly with assigned RBAC permissions.

showcase.sessionSecurity: In-memory accessToken (XSS-safe) + silent refreshToken on reload
showcase.sessionSecurityTooltip: Short-lived accessToken stays strictly in memory inside AuthSignalStore while refreshToken restores sessions seamlessly on page reload.
